text:
elaine: Heads-up: we hit a partial OOM on prod-gpu-7 during a high-concurrency KV-cache workload. Not a full outage but a lot of 502s. Need a short emergency play and a follow-up plan.

matt: Seeing the same. profiler shows workspace peaks at decode time (3-4x baseline). KV cache accounts for ~30% of resident memory. Kernel selector chose matmul_fallback on a few layers which increased memory temp buffers.

sanjay: Can you paste the profile? I grabbed a snippet:
```
$ runtimesrv profile --job=2026-03-17-oom --out=/tmp/oom.prof
peak_resident: 34.8GB
kvcache: 10.6GB (30.4%)
workspace_peak: 14.2GB
kernel_choice: matmul_fallback (layers 8-12)
```

hao: Two quick mitigations we can flip in prod ASAP: 
- request shaping: cap max_tokens per request to reduce workspace growth
- circuit breaker: per-model concurrent_request cap and soft-fail to queued responses
- enable fallback to q8 model variant when free_mem < threshold (fast but slightly lower perf)

elaine: Agreed. Emergency policy I'll push: concurrency cap = 60% of pool, max_tokens = 1024, enable kvcache-ttl eviction = 30s for non-auth customers. Also enable workspace soft-reserve reuse flag to allow buffer reuse between requests.

lenora: How do we set kvcache-ttl? config snippet: 
```
{
  "kvcache": {
    "ttl_seconds": 30,
    "eviction_policy": "LRU",
    "apply_to": "unauth"
  }
}
```

matt: I think 15s TTL might be safer for bursty traffic; 30s OK for steady. Also change kernel_selector heuristic: prefer cuBLAS matmul when seq_len > 512, otherwise optimized attention kernel. That should avoid matmul_fallback on long sequences.

sanjay: On allocator side: we should return ephemeral buffers earlier. Minimal change for safety: decrease min_workspace_reserve from 200MB -> 80MB on G32 nodes so we don't carve huge non-returnable blocks. Also enable eager_free for some transient buffers.

ops-bot: Policy applied to pool prod-gpu-7 by elaine: concurrency_cap=60%, max_tokens=1024, kvcache_ttl=30s, workspace_reuse=true (commit: 9b3ef4).

hao: Follow-ups: run a canary with simulated bursts, add Prometheus alerts for `oom_retries > 0` and `kvcache_hit_ratio drop >= 15%`, and create postmortem checklist (include kernel selection telemetry).

elaine: Assigning: Matt -> kernel selector PR, Sanjay -> allocator tuning, Lenora -> kvcache policy + metrics. I'll draft the incident note and link perf traces.

matt: :thumbsup: will open PR referencing this thread id 1842109876 and include perf numbers.

sanjay: I'll schedule a perf run on staging using stress script: `tools/stress/run_kv_burst.sh --concurrency 200 --seq 2048` and compare with and without min_workspace_reserve change.

lenora: Noted. Also suggest we add a small buffer_reuse threshold for tiny tensors (<1MB) to cut alloc churn.

elaine: Moving to done for triage. We'll reconvene in 30m after canary. Thanks everyone.
